title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix Clogs Safely
description: Chemical drain cleaners are often marketed as a quick fix for blocked drains, but they can cause severe long-term damage to plumbing systems. Caustic chemicals generate intense heat during exothermic reactions, which can deform PVC pipes or degrade old iron lines. Additionally, chemical solutions rarely clear complete blockages deep in the line, leaving standing toxic water that creates a safety hazard for technicians during manual clearing. Mechanical drain clearing using augers or hydro-jetting removes grease and heavy buildup safely without compromising pipe integrity or installer safety.
